feeds.title: Ride Shimano Blog
feeds.description: Experience the workout, community, and thrill of indoor cycling. SHIMANO Indoor Cycling strives to help you along the way with indoor cycling know-how and a curated collection of our favorite indoor cycling gear to help you go harder, faster, further.

feeds.title: Spinning Blog
feeds.description: The Spinning program is the global leader in indoor cycling training, education and equipment. SPIN aim to design and build the world's best performing indoor cycling bikes and accessories, creating the perfect bike for every type of rider.

feeds.title: ERIK'S Bike Shop Blog » Expert Advice
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with Indoor Cycling. ERIK'S is the Midwest's leading bike, snowboard & downhill ski retailer. We are passionate about our sports & experts on the gear.

feeds.title: Body Bike Blog
feeds.description: Check out tips, tricks, fun facts about indoor cycling with our blog. Body Bike offers the world's best indoor cycling experience. We do this through state-of-the-art technology, functional Scandinavian design and construction, customization, and a passion for our craftsmanship. High-quality indoor cycles with swift delivery and a high level of customization ensure a superior cycling experience.

feeds.title: For The Ride Inside
feeds.description: For The Ride Inside blog covers resources, insights and instructions for the riders who are interested in studio cycling. It also covers music playlists, ride profiles, guest posts, surveys, studio reviews, class schedules and much more.

feeds.title: Smart Bike Trainers » News
feeds.description: Read news and analysis on smart indoor bike trainers and top indoor cycling apps for your iOS, Android, Mac or Windows PC. Smart Bike Trainers is the ultimate guide to indoor smart bike trainers and indoor cycling apps. You will find hands-on reviews on most bike trainers on this site. I spend weeks on each trainer putting real training hours on it to get a real feel for the trainer. Then I share my thoughts with you.

feeds.title: Indoor Cycling Worldwide Blog
feeds.description: We are a non-profit organization that aims to strengthen the international development of indoor cycling. We provide support to new indoor cycling nations by building up and organizing their training and we also want to improve the public relation for indoor cycling with our work. Know more about various indoor cycling events happening worldwide, tournaments, results, news and more!

feeds.title: Average Joe Cyclist » Indoor Cycling Training
feeds.description: This is a blog for Average People who LOVE to ride bikes! Find reviews of cycling products and trails! Learn more on indoor cycling, product reviews, set-ups and more! We are Maggie and Joe, and we are average cyclists. We write a blog for people like us. People who love cycling but who don't necessarily look good in Lycra!

feeds.title: Indoor Cycling Channel
feeds.description: Indoor cycling Channel is a society of indoor cycling members, instructors, and spin studios. Every week we feature badass studios and rockstar Spin instructors.

feeds.title: Cycling Weekly » Indoor Cycling
feeds.description: Launched in 1891 Cycling Weekly is the world's oldest cycling magazine and the only one to be published weekly. The magazine covers domestic and international racing, offers in-depth training advice, tests the latest equipment, previews sportives across the UK and throughout Europe and much much more. This page contains all of our indoor cycling coverage, with news, reviews and buying guides to help you stay up to date and ensure you never miss an indoor fitness fix.

feeds.title: Sunny Health & Fitness » cycling workout
feeds.description: Become better with Sunny Health & Fitness blog. Workout with us inside your home gym on indoor cycling bikes, treadmills, ellipticals, rowers, and more. Discover more about cycling workouts, advantages and more in this section.

feeds.title: Indoor Cycling Teaching Ideas Blog
feeds.description: Everything Indoor Cycling for Instructors and enthusiasts. If your looking for ideas for drills and music in your classes check us out at Indoor Cycling Teaching Ideas. Indoor Cycling Class Ideas provides Drills, songs, playlists all in simple to-download ebooks to save Instructors time preparing classes.

feeds.title: Indoor Cycling Tips Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a source of all you need to know about getting started with Indoor Cycling including tips, advice, product reviews and more! I am a '40-something' cyclist well past his prime yet still taking cycling too seriously.
